{{Quote|Though designed for healing, I can use my tools for more aggressive purposes.|MHD-19|<ref name="Return to Hoth">{{SWIA|set=Return to Hoth}}</ref>}}
'''MHD-19''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] that was aligned with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] aided the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] Rebel marksman [[Loku Kanoloa/Legends|Loku Kanoloa]] and the Human female [[operative]] [[Verena Talos/Legends|Verena Talos]] in trying to evacuate some colonists from the Empire, they returned to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] forced them to evacuate.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I will do what I must to protect my fellow soldiers.|MHD-19|<ref name="Return to Hoth" />}}
Although MHD-19 was primarily and foremost a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]], being trained in over a thousand medical procedures, MHD-19 was also equipped with various weapons to aid comrades, being extremely loyal to the Rebellion.<ref name="Return to Hoth" />

==Behind the scenes==
MHD-19 is one of three hero characters in the [[Return to Hoth (expansion)|''Return to Hoth'']] expansion pack for the tactical land-based RPG game ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
